declared.title: Eight-minute self-regulation intervention raises educational attainment at scale in individualist but not collectivist cultures
declared.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
declared.foundIn: cited by kizilcec-2020-scale (full text, ref. 14); Crossref search « Kizilcec Cohen eight-minute self-regulation intervention raises educational attainment at scale » (2026-11-23)

population: 17,963 online learners in two randomized trials in MOOCs; countries grouped by Hofstede's individualism index

findings.text: In individualist cultures, learners who did MCII were more likely to complete the course than after a control activity

support.sentence: Learners in individualist cultures were 32% (first experiment) and 15% (second experiment) more likely to complete the course following the MCII intervention than a control activity.

findings.text: In collectivist cultures, MCII did not change course completion

support.sentence: In contrast, learners in collectivist cultures were unaffected by MCII.

findings.text: Across all countries together, MCII did not significantly raise course completion in either trial (a positive trend)

support.sentence: Across all cultural contexts, MCII did not significantly increase course completion relative to the control condition in either experiment, although there was a positive trend (experiment 1: b = 0.008, z = 1.66, P = 0.097; experiment 2: b = 0.021, z = 1.54, P = 0.122).
support.readBy: choose-your-struggle reviser, 2026-11-26: PMC page of PMC5410783 (Europe PMC full text answered 500), Results

findings.text: MCII did not raise course completion in collectivist countries, nor in culturally balanced ones

support.sentence: In contrast, MCII did not raise course completion in collectivist and culturally balanced countries (experiment 1: |bs| < 0.004, |zs| < 0.38, Ps > 0.70; experiment 2: |bs| < 0.023, |zs| < 0.67, Ps > 0.51).
support.readBy: choose-your-struggle reviser, 2026-11-26: PMC page of PMC5410783 (Europe PMC full text answered 500), Results

findings.text: Grouped by the cultural clusters of the World Values Survey (one of them African-Islamic), MCII had a significant effect only in the English-speaking cluster

support.sentence: The only cluster that yielded a significant effect of MCII was the English-Speaking cluster, which included Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
